p.i: Jesus Christ showed Himself to the Nephites when a large number of people had gathered in Bountiful; and He ministered to them. He appeared to them as described in the following account.

chapter.li: LEChapter11 Verse1 Now a large number of Nephites gathered around the temple in Bountiful. They were astonished, talking to each other in amazement, pointing out to each other the remarkable changes that had taken place. VerseEnd Verse2 They were also talking with each other about Jesus Christ, of whom the sign had been given about His death. VerseEnd

Verse3 While they were conversing about this, they heard a voice as if it came out of heaven. And they looked around, since they didn’t understand the voice they heard. It wasn’t a harsh voice or a loud voice. But despite being a quiet voice, it pierced those who heard it to the core, so much that they trembled. It cut them to the core and melted their hearts. VerseEnd Verse4 They heard the voice again but didn’t understand it. VerseEnd Verse5 And they heard the voice a third time and understood and listened attentively to it. They looked toward the sound, looking steadily toward heaven, where it originated. VerseEnd Verse6 At the third time, they understood the voice, and it said to them: VerseEnd Verse7 Here is My Beloved Son, in whom I’m well pleased, in whom I’ve glorified My name. Listen to Him! VerseEnd

Verse8 When they understood, they looked up again to heaven. They saw a man descending from heaven, and He was dressed in a white robe. He came down and stood among them, and the whole crowd was looking at Him. They didn’t dare speak, not even to each other, and they didn’t know what it meant, since they thought it was an angel appearing to them. VerseEnd

Verse9 He stretched out His hand and spoke to them, saying: VerseEnd Verse10 I Am Jesus Christ, whom the prophets testified would come into the world. VerseEnd Verse11 I Am the light and the life of the world. And I’ve drunk out of the bitter cup the Father has given Me and have glorified the Father by taking upon Myself the sins of the world, in which I’ve submitted to the Father’s will in all things from the beginning. VerseEnd Verse12 When Jesus said this, the whole crowd fell to the ground, since they remembered it had been prophesied to them that Christ would show Himself to them after His ascension into heaven. VerseEnd

Verse13 And the Lord spoke to them, saying: VerseEnd Verse14 Stand up and come up to Me, so 2PP you can put 2PP your hands in My side and 2PP you can feel the nail marks in My hands and feet, so 2PP you will know I Am the God of Israel and the God of the whole earth who was killed for the sins of the world. VerseEnd

Verse15 And the people went up and put their hands in His side and felt the nail marks in His hands and feet. They did this — going up one by one until they had all gone up — and saw with their eyes and felt with their hands and knew for certain and testified it was He the prophets wrote about, who was to come. VerseEnd Verse16 When they had all gone up and witnessed for themselves, they cried out as one: VerseEnd Verse17 Hallelujah! Blessed is the name of the Most High God! And they fell down at Jesus’ feet to worship Him. VerseEnd

Verse18 Then He spoke to Nephi who was in the crowd, and commanded him to approach. VerseEnd Verse19 So Nephi stood up and went to Him and bowed before the Lord, and he kissed His feet. VerseEnd Verse20 Then the Lord commanded him to stand up, and he got up and stood in front of Him. VerseEnd Verse21 And the Lord said to him: I give 2PSF you power to baptize this people when I’ve ascended into heaven again. VerseEnd

Verse22 Then the Lord called up others and said the same thing, giving them power to baptize. VerseEnd Verse24 Now these are the words that 2PP you must say, calling them by name, saying: VerseEnd Verse25 Having authority given to me by Jesus Christ, I baptize 2PSF you in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost. Amen. VerseEnd Verse26 And then 2PP you must immerse them under the water and bring them back out of the water. VerseEnd Verse27 This is the way 2PP you must baptize in My name. Verse31 Listen carefully to what I tell 2PP you: I will declare to 2PP you My doctrine. VerseEnd Verse33 And anyone who believes in Me and is baptized will be saved, and they are who will inherit God’s kingdom.
